title: Short-horizon mean reversion on BTC and ETH spot, hourly
hypothesis: Price-based short-horizon mean reversion produces no risk-adjusted edge after realistic costs, once selection across the full parameter space is accounted for.

search_space.enumeration_note: 3 families x 6 lookbacks x 5 thresholds x 3 exits x 3 caps x 2 symbols = 1620 fully enumerated variants. No variant excluded after the fact.

family_descriptions.zscore_reversion: z-score of close vs rolling mean, fade extremes
family_descriptions.bollinger_touch: intrabar high/low touch of Bollinger band, fade

data.source: binance public klines via data.binance.vision, see data/manifest/
data.holdout: 2025-07-01 onward — not loaded or inspected until the verdict is written

protocol.method: Fixed rules, no in-sample parameter fitting. Every variant evaluated over the full period; in-sample/out-of-sample splitting is done by CSCV at scoring time.
protocol.execution_model: next-bar open, no partial fills, position capped at 1x notional
protocol.survivorship_note: symbols fixed at the start of the period, no delisting selection

decision_rule.note: Fixed before any result was computed. Not adjustable.
